description: Fire a Sentry event as a scheduled (or on-demand) job — no asset materialized. Matches the pattern of http_webhook_job / observability_heartbeat_job. Configurable message, level, tags, extras, fingerprint, environment, release.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: 'STOPPED' or 'RUNNING' — controls the schedule's default status on load.

dsn_env_var.label: Dsn Env Var
dsn_env_var.description: Env var holding the Sentry DSN.

message.label: Message
message.description: Event message text ({now} → UTC ISO timestamp).

level.label: Level
level.description: One of: debug / info / warning / error / fatal.

release.label: Release
release.description: Sentry release tag (e.g. app version or git SHA).

sentry_tags.label: Sentry Tags
sentry_tags.description: Searchable Sentry tags applied to the event.

fingerprint.label: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Sentry fingerprint (grouping key). Default is Sentry's auto-grouping.

fail_on_error.label: Fail On Error
fail_on_error.description: If True (default) the job step fails when sentry-sdk raises. Set False for fire-and-forget heartbeats that must not break the schedule if Sentry is down.
